preconditions.description: The number of columns n in the table is between 1 and 100000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly 2n - 1, forming a tree with 2n nodes.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 2 * n and 1 <= bi <= 2 * n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes, each numbered between 1 and 2n inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer.
The output is a non-negative integer less than 1000000007.
The output is the number of valid ways to place the tree on the table modulo 1000000007.
